title: Penthouse Sept 1994 25th Anniversary Collector's Edition Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Silver cover has light edge wear, small creases along the spine and a scuffed top-left corner (see close-ups). Spine intact.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, September 1994 - Special Collector's Edition, 25th Anniversary issue with the silver cover. Original $7.50 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold.

Back cover: Goldschlager cinnamon schnapps ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
